name: @limio/ot-buy
description: OpenText Business Network guided buying: pick your ERP (Trading Grid), search and select trading partners from a directory with the EDI documents each one needs, get the plan recommended for your partner count, choose self-service or guided onboarding, then check out. One page serves USD, GBP and EUR; the region picker also sets the provisioning data centre. Selections travel on the order as customFields (OT_ERP, OT_TradingPartners, OT_Region, …).

limioProps.default: Connect your ERP to your retailers. Live in days, not months.

limioProps.label: Subheadline
limioProps.default: Pick your ERP and partners. We set up your connections the moment you check out.

limioProps.label: Step: partners hint

limioProps.label: Step: plan hint
